purpose: Test whether direct semantic comparison can distinguish correct from incorrect sibling reasoning paths at equal online token horizons.

dataset.name: lscpku/OlympiadBench-official
dataset.pair_selection: all correct-versus-incorrect sibling pairs on mixed-outcome problems

generator.prefix_source: exact saved generator output token IDs

verifier.order_aggregation: mean canonical win probability after A/B swap
verifier.score_source: exact requested next-token logprobs renormalized over A/B

analysis.pointwise_comparison: error-audit-v1 scores on the identical fixed prefixes
